item.title: How Elon Musk paved the way for Jensen Huang’s return
item.dc:creator: Faiz Siddiqui
item.description: The billionaire Tesla CEO once endured similar calls for his job after a string of scandals, including allegedly misleading investors.

item.title: Hegseth, Pentagon officials floated using wartime law to reappoint Nvidia CEO
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Dwoskin, Tara Copp, Nancy Cook, Natalie Allison
item.description: The Cold War-era Defense Production Act gives presidents extraordinary power to intervene in the economy. Deploying it to restore Jensen Huang had been a popular idea in some Silicon Valley circles.

item.title: New Meta settlement changes will affect only 8 percent of teens, study says
item.dc:creator: Shannon Osaka
item.description: Most teens will not have social media use curtailed by the recent settlement, analysis in JAMA finds.
